review.summary: The patch matches all stated requirements: it sets quarkus.thread-pool.max-threads=${QUARKUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_THREADS:8} in application.properties, documents the variable in the README configuration table (default 8, required=false), and adds a focused unit test covering default and env-var override resolution. No out-of-scope or unsafe changes were found.

findings.claim: AC4 (compiles and passes mvn test) cannot be statically verified from the patch alone; the test uses SmallRye Config APIs (PropertiesConfigSource(URL,int), EnvConfigSource(Map,int), addDefaultInterceptors with expression expansion) that are provided transitively by Quarkus, and assumes the repo-provided @UnitTest annotation (org.folio.support.types.UnitTest) exists.
findings.evidence: Test imports io.smallrye.config.{EnvConfigSource,PropertiesConfigSource,SmallRyeConfig,SmallRyeConfigBuilder} and org.folio.support.types.UnitTest; these are standard/likely-present dependencies but their availability cannot be proven from the diff.

findings.claim: The NEWS.md entry is an addition beyond the literal requirements, but it follows the file's existing release-notes convention and directly describes this change (MODSIDECAR-208), so it is not an out-of-scope edit.
findings.evidence: +* Set default Quarkus worker thread pool size to 8 and make it configurable via `QUARKUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_THREADS` to prevent thread exhaustion during bulk exports ([MODSIDECAR-208](https://folio-org.atlassian.net/browse/MODSIDECAR-208))

findings.claim: The property is implemented exactly as required: named property with env-var expression expansion and default 8, satisfying AC1 and AC2 (SmallRye/Quarkus resolves ${VAR:8} and env sources take precedence over application.properties).
README table row documents the variable with default value (8), required flag (false), and a description, satisfying AC3 and matching the surrounding table format.
findings.evidence: | QUARKUS_THREAD_POOL_MAX_THREADS              | 8                       |  false   | Maximum size of the Quarkus worker thread pool. Prevents thread exhaustion under heavy concurrent load (e.g. bulk export with custom profiles); can be increased for workloads that require higher concurrency.                                                 |
